## Plain custom NPCs on Schedule I 0.4.7f6

- Fix both the legacy constructor and `ConfigurePrefab` path failing after f6 removed `ConsumeProductBehaviour.onConsumeDone`.
- Keep the legacy event initialization for older game builds that still expose it.

## Compatibility and validation

- No S1API public signatures, save identifiers, or network formats changed.
- Both contact paths registered after loading a save on local 0.4.7f6 Mono (Steam build 25439857) and IL2CPP (25439817) installs. The Mono and IL2CPP contract suites passed.
- This is a GitHub-only prerelease for the game beta. It does not publish to NuGet, Nexus Mods, or Thunderstore.
- Fixes [issue #309](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/issues/309) with [PR #311](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/311).
